content.json:
# Trustee Notification Pipeline

Visibility into the trustee-change-notification / ACS bounce-poll pipeline: send volume, bounce-poll job health, and per-email bounce detail.

## Poll Health Status

One row per 15-minute bounce-poll tick (`POLL-NOTIFICATION-BOUNCES`). Every tick is labeled into exactly one state: `Didn't run`, `Ran, query failed`, `Ran, zero bounces`, `Ran, partial reconstruction failure`, or `Ran, bounces reconstructed`. The underlying error text is shown verbatim for any failed tick -- never just a status label.

content.query:
let binSize = 15m;
let rangeStart = bin({TimeRange:start}, binSize);
let rangeEnd = bin({TimeRange:end}, binSize);
let expectedTicks = range TimeBin from rangeStart to rangeEnd step binSize;
let actualRuns = customEvents
| where name == "DataflowHandlerComplete"
| where tostring(customDimensions.moduleName) == "POLL-NOTIFICATION-BOUNCES"
| extend TimeBin = bin(timestamp, binSize),
         success = tostring(customDimensions.success),
         errorText = tostring(customDimensions.error),
         hasBouncesFound = isnotempty(customDimensions.bouncesFound),
         bouncesFound = toint(customDimensions.bouncesFound),
         bouncesExpired = toint(customDimensions.bouncesExpired),
         documentsFailed = toint(customMeasurements.documentsFailed)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, success, errorText, hasBouncesFound, bouncesFound, bouncesExpired, documentsFailed) by TimeBin;
expectedTicks
| join kind=leftouter (actualRuns) on TimeBin
| extend Status = case(
    isnull(timestamp), "Didn't run",
    success == "false" and not(hasBouncesFound), "Ran, query failed",
    documentsFailed > 0, "Ran, partial reconstruction failure",
    bouncesFound == 0, "Ran, zero bounces",
    "Ran, bounces reconstructed")
| project TimeBin, Status, errorText, bouncesFound, bouncesExpired, documentsFailed
| order by TimeBin desc
content.title: Poll Health by 15-Minute Tick

content.json:
## Sent Volume & Bounce Rate

How many trustee-change notification attempts were made (successful sends and synchronous ACS rejections that still received a messageId, e.g. `Suppressed`), and what fraction of those were later found in ACS's delivery-status log as failed/bounced/quarantined/filtered-spam/suppressed.

content.query:
let bounced = workspace('{LogAnalyticsWorkspace:name}').ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
    | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where DeliveryStatus in ('Failed', 'Bounced', 'Quarantined', 'FilteredSpam', 'Suppressed')
    | summarize BouncedTime = min(todatetime(TimeGenerated)) by RecipientId;
let attempted = app('{NodeApiAppInsights:name}').traces
    | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where message has "[ACS-NOTIFICATION-GATEWAY]" and (message has "Email sent successfully" or message has "Failed to send email")
    | extend messageId = extract(@'"messageId"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, message),
             recipientEmail = extract(@'"to"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, message),
             trusteeId = extract(@'"trusteeId"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, message)
    | where isnotempty(recipientEmail)
    | extend messageId = coalesce(messageId, strcat("failed-", recipientEmail, "-", format_datetime(timestamp, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')))
    | summarize SendTime = min(todatetime(timestamp)) by messageId, recipientEmail;
attempted
| join kind=leftouter (bounced) on $left.recipientEmail == $right.RecipientId
| summarize AttemptedCount = dcount(messageId), 
            BouncedCount = dcountif(messageId, isnotempty(BouncedTime))
| extend BounceRatePercent = round(100.0 * BouncedCount / AttemptedCount, 1)
content.title: Attempted Notifications & Bounce Rate

content.json:
## Suppression/Bounce Detail Table

One row per bounced/suppressed email in the selected time range, joined to its original send-time log line to resolve recipient and trustee identity -- so you don't need direct access to the (TTL'd, 7-day) archive collection to identify who was affected. Rows with no matching send-time trace (e.g. the trace has aged out of retention) are still shown, with Recipient/Trustee marked `Unavailable` rather than being hidden.

content.query:
let sendTraces = app('{NodeApiAppInsights:name}').traces
    | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where message has "[ACS-NOTIFICATION-GATEWAY]" and (message has "Email sent successfully" or message has "Failed to send email")
    | extend jsonStart = indexof(message, "{")
    | extend data = iif(jsonStart >= 0, parse_json(substring(message, jsonStart)), dynamic(null))
    | extend messageId = tostring(coalesce(data.messageId, data.id)),
             recipient = tostring(data["to"]),
             trusteeId = tostring(data.trusteeId),
             invocationId = tostring(data.correlationId)
    | where isnotempty(recipient)
    | summarize arg_max(timestamp, recipient, trusteeId, invocationId) by messageId, recipient;
let statusEvents = workspace('{LogAnalyticsWorkspace:name}').ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
    | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where DeliveryStatus in ('Delivered', 'Failed', 'Bounced', 'Quarantined', 'FilteredSpam', 'Suppressed')
    | project BouncedTime = TimeGenerated, RecipientId, DeliveryStatus, CorrelationId, InternetMessageId;
statusEvents
| join kind=leftouter (sendTraces) on $left.RecipientId == $right.recipient
| project TimeGenerated = BouncedTime,
          Recipient = coalesce(recipient, RecipientId),
          TrusteeId = coalesce(trusteeId, "Unavailable"),
          DeliveryStatus,
          NodeMessageId = messageId,
          ACSCorrelationId = CorrelationId,
          InternetMessageId
content.title: Bounce & Suppression Detail
